commands.summary: Decision 0061 -- Remote Repository Providers Materialize Immutable Snapshots Through Native-Owned Authorization and the Existing Workspace Pipeline -- created and accepted. Binds: provider-neutral remote acquisition; GitHub as first provider; native-owned authentication; GitHub App (not classic OAuth App); least privilege (contents:read, metadata:read only); the auth-flow threat model and comparison; the credential storage boundary; immutable revision resolution; bounded snapshot download; reuse of the existing safe archive materializer; snapshot provenance; typed native commands (named, not yet implemented); offline post-import behavior; and the Stage-2 Git separation from WI068.

commands.command: WebFetch https://docs.github.com/en/apps/oauth-apps/building-oauth-apps/authorizing-oauth-apps ; WebFetch https://docs.github.com/en/apps/creating-github-apps/authenticating-with-a-github-app/generating-a-user-access-token-for-a-github-app ; WebSearch 'GitHub App device flow authorizing users client_secret required'
commands.summary: Live GitHub documentation consulted 2026-09-15 (not assumed from training knowledge alone). Confirmed: (1) the web+PKCE flow's token-exchange step still lists client_secret as required despite PKCE support -- rejected for a distributed native client that cannot keep a secret confidential; (2) GitHub's own documentation states a client_secret is required to generate access tokens 'unless your app uses the device flow' -- device flow confirmed as the one no-secret path; (3) exact device-flow request/response shape (device_code/user_code/verification_uri/expires_in/interval; grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code; polling errors authorization_pending/slow_down/expired_token/access_denied/device_flow_disabled); (4) token expiration model (access token 8h/28800s, refresh token 6 months/15897600s when 'Expire user authorization tokens' is enabled); (5) GitHub's own guidance names desktop applications as an intended device-flow audience. This confirmed rather than assumed the operator's stated architectural preference; the alternative (hosted ForgeWire Labs broker) was rejected per WI067 GH-003's own text that a hosted service is not required merely to import a repository.
